verdict.rationale: Discord's first-party docs describe a Gateway API through which apps open secure WebSocket connections to receive real-time events about server actions (discord-docs-10, discord-docs-20). The docs also cover HTTP-delivered event notifications (discord-docs-56) and bot-token authentication (discord-docs-4, discord-docs-17), and position the platform for building bots (discord-docs-41). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the gateway in practice, and explicit evidence that message-create events specifically are delivered.
